$comment: Committed on purpose. These guardrails apply to everyone working in this repo,
including future you at 2am in finals week. Machine-local overrides belong in
PreToolUse  - prevention. Pure path check, no tree scan. Must stay fast.
PostToolUse - targeted detection. Full sweep only after a .vbproj edit.
Stop        - full sweep once per turn. Catches what the other two skip.
Interpreter is pwsh (PowerShell 7). It measured ~640ms per invocation on the dev
machine against ~1820ms for Windows PowerShell 5.1. If pwsh is ever unavailable,
swap 'pwsh' for 'powershell.exe' below - the scripts run under both. Nothing here
depends on jq: the hook payload is parsed with ConvertFrom-Json.
These hooks fire only when CLAUDE edits a file. Visual Studio edits bypass them
entirely - that is what the git pre-commit hook is for. See CLAUDE.md section 11.
